title: Correct output, value guarantee, and work bound
statement: Let $D$ be a finite nonempty label set, let a finite predicate template have maximum arity $r$, and consider a finite CSP input with $n$ variables and $m$ constraints, supplied with a randomized assignment. Suppose binary input and output encodings have decoding inverse to encoding and every successfully decoded string is canonical, and an adapter algorithm maps each encoded input to the encoding of the packed assignment in its conditional-expectation plan. For every encoded input, decoding the algorithm's output gives that packed assignment, the value of the plan's assignment is at least the expected CSP value of the randomized assignment, and the plan's work is at most $|D|(|D|^r+1)(n+m)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite predicate template and its maximum arity
Finite randomized CSP input with variable count, constraints, and randomized assignment
Binary input and output encodings with the stated inverse properties
Adapter algorithm has the specified output on every encoded input
